Description
Les Roches is an international business school focused on developing leaders within the hospitality and experience industries across a global network of campuses in Switzerland, Spain and China. Les Roches ranks among the world's top 3 institutions for hospitality and leisure management, and among the world’s top 3 for employer reputation. (QS World University Rankings by Subject, 2019).
